root_cause: Style.clear_meta_and_links() builds a copy with _link=None, _link_id='' and _meta=None but copies the cached hash (style._hash = self._hash). Style.__hash__ includes _link and _meta, so the new style keeps a stale hash that no longer matches its own contents.
best_solution: In Style.clear_meta_and_links (rich/style.py), set style._hash = None instead of copying self._hash, so __hash__ recomputes lazily from the cleared fields. The title 'Clear hashed cache when clearing meta' plus a grep for clear_meta_and_links and _hash leads straight to the one line.
acceptable_alternatives: Recompute the hash eagerly, or drop the cached hash some other way, as long as clear_style._hash is None right after the call. Eager recompute would fail the hidden test, which asserts _hash is None.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_style.py::test_clear_meta_and_links_clears_hash: parse 'bold red on black link https://example.org' + Style.on(click='CLICK'), call hash(style) so the hash gets cached, assert style._hash is not None, then assert style.clear_meta_and_links()._hash is None. The private attribute must be exactly None, not merely a correct hash value.
locating_signals: The title names the concepts 'hashed cache' and 'clearing meta', which map to the _hash attribute and the method clear_meta_and_links. The function is not named verbatim in the statement, and the linked issue #2942 (which gives the line) is not included, but a grep for 'meta' plus '_hash' in style.py finds it right away.
our_outcome_summary: Passed in the Kaggle env on all four configs (v4, v6, v7, v8). All four agent patches are byte-identical to the gold patch (style._hash = None). Pod runs took 33-69 s and 14-39 calls; v8 used the most calls (39) for the same one-line result.
generalizable_lesson: When a copy-or-clone method changes fields that feed a cached derived value (hash, memoized repr, cached property), invalidate the cache (set it to None or the sentinel) rather than copying or eagerly recomputing it. Hidden tests often check the private cache attribute directly. A short PR-title-only statement like 'clear X cache when clearing Y' usually maps to one line in the method named after Y.
